warnings: House title block: 'บ้านครอบครัวไทยร่วมสมัย 10' — 'แบบบ้านสานฝัน ของขวัญปีใหม่ คนไทยมีความสุข' series (กรมโยธาธิการและผังเมือง กระทรวงมหาดไทย), sheet no. S59033. This is a DIFFERENT series from the 'แบบบ้านยิ้มเพื่อประชาชน' series used as the template reference (houses 09/12/14/16/18/19/20) — confirmed by reading this house's own title block on หน้า01-03/29, not assumed from the folder name. 2-story RC house, single-span (3x4 = grid1-4 x grid A-F) structure, hip roof framed entirely in structural steel (channel rafters/ridge/hip on RC ring beam).

Main x/y grids (1-4, A-F) resolved from the identical dimension chain printed on S-02/S-03/S-04/S-05/S-06 (9.00m = 4.00+2.00+3.00 on x; 13.40m = 2.00+3.70+2.20+3.70+1.80 on y for the F-A range). Chain closes exactly on every sheet that prints it — high confidence.

Dummy x-line '4\'' (pos_m 9.60, grid4+0.60): a small bump-out east of grid4 between rows D-C houses the stair LANDING platform (ระดับชานพัก) — confirmed by S-11/S-12 stair sections and by the 'B1/B2ที่ระดับชานพัก' callouts on S-05 — carried by short columns 'CN' that per S-09's note only rise from floor-1 level to landing level (not full-height). Same x=9.60 line is reused by a second, unrelated small beam stub 'BX1' at row B (see dummy 'B\'' below) — both sit 0.60m east of grid4, confirmed independently from their own printed '0.60' dimensions on S-04/S-06.

Dummy y-lines 'D\'' (6.50), 'D\'\'' (7.10) and 'C\'' (9.65), 'C\'\'' (11.40): four short RC roof struts marked 'CX' on the ring-beam plan (S-06/หน้า34), each positioned by its own printed offset dimension (0.80/0.80 below row D at grid2+0.50 for the first pair; 1.75 below row C and ~0.20 above row B at grid1+2.00 for the second pair). Per S-09, CX rises from the ring-beam level up to the roof structure (roof strut/king-post), not a primary framing column — included for completeness since exact dimensions were printed, but these are minor relative to the main beam grid.
Dummy x-line '1\'' (pos_m 2.00, grid1+2.00) and '2\'' (pos_m 4.50, grid2+0.50): x-positions of the CX struts above, read directly off S-06's own printed offsets.
Dummy y-line 'B\'' (pos_m 12.20, row B+0.60): south edge of the small 'BX1' beam stub (0.40x0.40 per S-08) east of grid4 at row B, read off S-04's printed '0.60'/'1.50' dimensions.

'1.00m north of row F' (grid1-2 bay only, over a double-thin-line boundary enclosing an 'SOA' slab-type marker, on S-04/หน้า32): NOT given a dummy grid line. No beam lands on it — the boundary has no hatched corner node like every real beam does, and 'SOA' is a slab-TYPE marker (§10 slab-marker family), so this reads as a slab-type transition line for a canopy/carport bay, not a structural beam. Recorded in dimension_chains as an edge-to-F segment per the sheet's own vertical dimension string, but flagged: it is genuinely ambiguous whether this 1.00m applies to the whole row-F edge or only the grid1-2 bay (the B3/B4 beam rectangle spanning grid2-4 sits exactly on the F line with no extension, so it is plausibly local to the SOA bay only) — not resolvable from the structural sheets alone (would need the architectural roof/site plan, out of op04 scope).

Roof-plan (S-07/หน้า35) overhangs (1.00m each side, x and y) are steel-rafter/eave reach with no individual grid_ref (spacing-based repeated member, like purlins) — no dummy grid added for them, consistent with the established rule that an overhang only gets a dummy grid when a discrete beam/column endpoint lands there. Recorded in dimension_chains as edge segments instead.

Compressed duplicate dimension_chains: S-02 and S-03 (footing plans) print the identical F-A/1-4 chain with no edge overhangs; S-04, S-05 and S-06 all print the identical chain WITH the 0.60/0.50 edge overhangs (S-06 omits row F, since its content only spans E-A). Rather than 6 near-duplicate entries per §4's letter, one representative source_image is kept per DISTINCT chain shape (4 x-chain shapes, 4 y-chain shapes) and this note records which sheets repeat it verbatim, to keep the file legible without losing the 'record every printed row' intent.

z_levels only carries two confirmed numeric levels: 'ระดับอ้างอิง' (±0.00, from S-10's fin detail) and 'อะเส' (+7.45, from S-09's column schedule, the ring-beam/roof level). Floor-1, floor-2 and landing levels are drawn on S-11/S-12 stair sections and S-09's column table only as unlabelled datum triangles/arrows with no printed metre value anywhere in the structural set (they are dimensioned on the architecture side_profile/elevation sheets instead, out of op04 scope) — left out of z_levels rather than invented; the relative floor-to-floor rise is NOT derivable from the pages read for this extraction.

A local elevation note '+6.65' printed next to the landing beam label ('RB1/RB1+6.65') on S-06, and two local levels '+0.50' and '+0.20' on S-10's fin/kerb ('ขยาย2') details, are NOT added to z_levels (they are local top-of-member elevations for one specific beam/detail, not building-wide floor levels) — recorded in unassigned_dimensions instead.
